task: Find an energetic hairless dog with medium barking.
agent_final_answer:
American Hairless Terrier.

This breed matches all three criteria on akc.org:
- Hairless: Coat Type = Hairless
- Medium barking: Barking Level = Medium
- Energetic: AKC describes its temperament as "alert / curious / energetic"

Found by filtering the AKC Dog Breeds page (Explore Breeds) with Coat Type = Hairless and Barking Level = Medium, which returned 4 breeds (American Hairless Terrier, Chinese Crested, Peruvian Inca Orchid, Xoloitzcuintli). Of these, only the American Hairless Terrier is described as "energetic".
